# Newlink Realty

> Newlink Realty is an Australian real estate agency helping people buy, sell, rent and manage property with clear advice and local knowledge.

## Primary services

- Residential sales: positioning, marketing and negotiation for homes and apartments.
- Residential rentals: browse available rentals, inspections and rental alerts.
- Property management: ongoing management and rental appraisals for property owners.
- Commercial and rural property: leasing, sales and practical advice for land and business spaces.

## Brand facts

- Business name: Newlink Realty
- Phone: 0420 717 777
- Email: info@newlinkrealty.com.au
- Service area: Albury, Albury-Wodonga and surrounding New South Wales and Victoria markets.
- Brand values: trust, honest advice, local knowledge, personal service and focused results.
